# AFRICA OF HOPE School of Professional Studies — llms.txt
# Canonical site: https://africaofhopelr.org

> AFRICA OF HOPE School of Professional Studies is a practical training school at Boystown Junction, Lower Margibi, Liberia. It offers short certificate programmes (two-week, one-month, three-month and six-month tracks) in trades, technology, business and hospitality for high-school leavers and working adults. Tuition is sponsored: learners pay only a one-time registration package of US$5 (two-week), US$10 (one-month), US$30 (three-month) or US$45 (six-month). Strictly online students can enrol anytime; on-site cohorts follow the published term calendar. Every certificate carries a unique serial number verifiable live on the Verify page. The school does not offer degree programmes and never issues a certificate without completed coursework.

## Questions and answers
### What is AFRICA OF HOPE School of Professional Studies?
AFRICA OF HOPE is a practical training school at Boystown Junction, Lower Margibi, Liberia. It offers short certificate programmes in trades, technology, business and hospitality, with mentors who guide learners from enrolment to graduation.

### What courses can I study?
Two-week, one-month, three-month and six-month certificate tracks, including computer studies, tailoring, catering, electrical work, plumbing and business. Fully online study is 1 hour a day, 3 days a week; fully on-site study is 2 hours daily, 2 days a week.

### How much does it cost?
Tuition is sponsored. You pay only a one-time registration package: US$5 for two-week courses, US$10 for one-month courses, US$30 for three-month courses and US$45 for six-month courses. A seat can be reserved with half of the package.

### How do admissions work?
Admissions for 2026/2027 are open. Strictly online students can enrol anytime once they meet the requirements — pick your 3 training days, attend within them, finish within the course duration and receive your certificate on completion. Apply online in minutes from https://africaofhopelr.org/admissions.

### Who is AFRICA OF HOPE for, and what does it not do?
It is for high-school leavers and working adults in Liberia who want practical, job-ready skills with a verifiable certificate. It does not offer degree programmes, and it never issues a certificate without completed coursework — any credential can be checked on the Verify page.

### Where is the school and how do I contact it?

### How can an employer verify my certificate?
Every certificate carries a unique serial number. Enter it at https://africaofhopelr.org/verify and it is checked live against the institutional register. A valid result shows the holder's name, programme and issue date; revoked certificates are reported as revoked.

### Where is the school and how do I contact it?
Boystown Junction, Lower Margibi, Liberia. Phone/WhatsApp +231776679963, email afrohope033@gmail.com.
